name: incremental-work-order
description: A dispatch workflow for long-running coding agents: one main tree schedules, sub-trees execute their own work orders, batches end in checkpoints that are inspection windows rather than stops, and merges back are approval-gated and re-verified.

plugins.name: incremental-work-order
plugins.description: Dispatch long-running agent work through repository-backed work orders: one main tree schedules, each sub-tree executes its own slice, batches produce git checkpoints that never stop the executor, and every gate must be shown to fail.
